claim: Socioboard Core is an open source social media management, analytics and reporting platform supporting nine networks
Features: schedule content, task assignment, RSS feeds, auto email reports, analytics, team collaboration
5.0 is a centralized API in Node.js, Express, Mongoose and Sequelize, with a PHP front end
Requirements: Node, npm, PM2, nodemon, MongoDB, MySQL and minimum 5 free ports; four microservices
Configuration links for 5.0 'will be added soon'
Commercial SaaS version at socioboard.com and open source version at socioboard.org
Customizable and extensible in the form of plugins
LICENSE file in the repository is GNU GPL version 3
